notes.title: 🔥Major Version Update｜Desert Rescue Battle Officially Begins!
notes.notes:
The flames of war are about to reignite, and the Kingdom is once again in crisis!

Beneath the guise of peace, the Dark Faction has already laid out an inescapable net. In this brand-new version, you will delve deep into unknown desert territories to rescue the exiled Prince, help him return to the capital, and wage the final decisive battle against the long-hidden Dark Faction!


This Version Update at a Glance:


New Desert Terrain Added

Unfamiliar landscapes hide unknown dangers. Respected Viceroy, are you ready to face new challenges?


10 New Aides-de-camp

Each possesses unique abilities and backstories, waiting for you to unleash their potential!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/c013327f25938405a0b4ecc6260c57e5c50e3ea4.gif"]
40 New Cards
 Brand-new tactical combinations and deck-building strategies to help you stand out on the desert battlefield!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/e356eaec4a8c70bfaf8ad7f5eecb3a3cdeddff04.png"]

30 New Enemies

Monsters formed from sand and magic await your challenge

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/d2bfa8b91a89cdc4dc20678278a2687abf7cc5ed.gif"]
28 Chest Upgrades

Unlock more strategic options and resource acquisition paths!


7 New Main Story Missions

Venture deep into the desert to uncover the truth behind the Dark Faction’s conspiracy!


Exploration Mechanics Completely Revamped!

In the DLC map, the monthly quest system will be replaced by a brand-new exploration gameplay, bringing more strategic challenges!

Balance Adjustments
Adjustments have been made to numerous in-game stats for balancing purposes


⚔️Are you ready to face new challenges? The fate of the Kingdom rests on your shoulders!

notes.title: Patch v0.99.33

notes.title: Patch v0.99.32

Removed the healing effect from the Giant Mushy (this can still be weakened via bonfires).
 Fixed a bug where the Output Crown would disappear.
 Reduced penalties for festival events.
 Fixed an issue where units would continuously call "SOS" if too many critically injured units were queued for recovery.
 Fixed a bug where the Giant Mushy had an incorrect attack range.

notes.title: Patch v0.99.30
notes.notes:
Added supplies consumption display to unit interfaces.
 Fixed a bug where the Bonfire consumed supplies incorrectly. It now consumes 1 supply per turn.
 Golems no longer consume food and now consume supplies instead.
 Fixed a bug where summoned units spawned with incomplete health.
 Fixed a bug with incorrect Fortress upgrades.

 Fixed a bug where the Blade Wall could not be attacked.
 Fixed a bug where Mushy could not be enhanced by Snowfield Goblins and Snowfield Orcs.

notes.title: Patch v0.99.29

notes.title: Patch v0.99.28

notes.title: Patch v0.99.27

Decreased the health increase value of the Barracks

notes.title: Patch v0.99.26

notes.title: Patch v0.99.25

notes.title: The update to version 0.99.10 may cause errors in existing game sessions.
notes.notes:
Due to adjustments in the save mechanism in version 0.99.10, incompatibility issues may arise in ongoing games. This could result in bugs such as incorrect monster spawn points, failure to spawn monsters properly, or incorrect display of game objectives.
These issues will be resolved when starting a new game.

notes.title: We're excited to announce the release date for Border Pioneer!
notes.notes:
⚔️ Border Pioneer will be releasing on Thursday, 6 February 2025 14:00 GMT!

As the saying goes, if you build it, they will come… and try to knock it down. The perfect blend of city-builder and tower defense, forge the fortress of your dreams, and try to stop it all crashing and burning before your eyes.

In a deliciously nostalgic pixel style, this strategy game offers an array of treacherous terrains, diverse foes and unforeseen dangers to discover as you expand your borders. As unchartered territories are claimed and enemies are vanquished, you will be rewarded with new elements to help grow and fortify your settlements.

💸 Launch discounts! 

There will be a launch discount, as well as an extra discount if you pick up the game alongside Stray Path, another strategy game published by Gamersky and Yogscast Games, that will be launching at the same time!


You can watch the release date trailer here. Save the date!
